text:
alex chen: Heads up — got a customer report of a short 502 spike hitting /v1/generate (~10:45 UTC). Can someone point me to the dashboards/log queries so I can grab traces and propose temporary alert quieting? Not sure if it's prefix-cache or upstream timeouts.

marco r: Start with the Errors by Route grafana dash (last 15m): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/errors-by-route?orgId=1&var-route=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate
Also check the 502 heatmap: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/efgh/502-heatmap

priya das: Loki quick query to capture 502 lines from gateway:
```
{job="gateway"} |= "502" | json | line_format "{timestamp} {request_id} {msg}"
```
Then grab a couple request_ids and search Jaeger/traces dashboard by trace_id or request_id.

luis rivera: PS you can pull sample traces via the internal requests API:
curl -s "https://observability.internal/api/requests?route=/v1/generate&status=502&limit=20" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OBS_KEY"

alex chen: thanks — quick Q on alerting: current paging is "route 502% > 0.5% over 5m" which paged on this. Thinking of proposing a temporary quieting for /v1/generate while we investigate. Thoughts?

marco r: I support temporary quieting for 10m. Proposal: add a debounce layer — require count>20 and rate>0.5% over 10m to page. That avoids noisy short bursts. Link to runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/ingress-502-triage

priya das: FYI I see kvcache timeout traces for some of those request_ids — search logs for "kvcache timeout" and metric kv.cache.latency_p95. If that's high, we should escalate infra/redis.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-459 — https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-459 — auto-attached logs/grafana snapshots.

jon p: I'll take the trace pull and check upstream latency to model servers. If it's cache, we may see upstream timeouts in envoy: envoy_downstream_rx_timeout or upstream_rq_timeout.

alex chen: got a few trace samples, uploaded to the incident doc. I'll submit a small alert tweak PR to add a 10m temporary debounce and post the change here for review. Thanks for the help :thumbsup:
